title: Personal generation rules
description: The parsed form of profile/rules.md — hand-written by the person as Markdown (## sections, - bullets), read (never written) by the generation skill. This schema describes what generate.py parses that file into, and the shape of default_rules in generate.config.json; the person never types JSON. Every section is optional: anything absent falls back to default_rules, and present sections override the default key-by-key.

$schema_version.description: Legacy only — a pre-Markdown profile/rules.json still carries it. rules.md has no equivalent and needs none.

exclude.description: Filtered out before any exercise is picked. Unknown names are reported as warnings, never silently skipped.

equipment.description: Dataset equipment values to avoid even when the gym tier allows them.

movement_groups.description: Dataset movement-group values to avoid entirely.

muscles.description: Muscle groups to drop from the plan entirely (injury, personal choice).
Groups this program biases toward when picking exercises.

must_include.description: Exact dataset exercise names flagged must_include in the brief when equipment and gates allow; the coach places them.

order.description: Session ordering rules, applied top-down: the first rule is the primary sort key, each later rule breaks remaining ties.
